title: A startup claims it broke through a bottleneck that's holding back LLMs
summary: Subquadratic has now shared more details about its new model. But some are still skeptical.
reason: 大语言模型性能瓶颈是当前 AI 发展的关键问题，任何突破都可能影响整个行业走向。

title: Want to get a data center online quickly? Give it some flex.
summary: As the data-center boom puts pressure on the grid, some companies say the answer isn't just more power plants but software that dials down centers' energy-guzzling ways when demand spikes.
reason: AI 算力的能源消耗是可持续发展的重要议题，柔性管理方案值得关注。

title: Why do South Koreans love AI so much?
summary: From eldercare robots to humanoid monks, South Koreans just can't get enough of AI.
reason: 了解不同地区的 AI 应用普及情况，有助于理解全球 AI 发展差异和文化接受度。

title: Google DeepMind is worried about what happens when millions of agents start to interact
summary: The firm is calling for more scientists to study the risks of multi-agent systems.
reason: 多智能体系统的风险是 AI 安全研究的前沿话题，DeepMind 的呼吁具有权威性。

title: The Meta hack shows there's more to AI security than Mythos
summary: Some AI cybersecurity threats are incredibly simple. They're still dangerous.
reason: AI 安全不仅是复杂的技术问题，简单的攻击方式同样危险，Meta 案例具有警示意义。

title: How courts are coping with a flood of AI-generated lawsuits
summary: Judges are wondering what rights and duties chatbots should have as they stand in for lawyers.
reason: AI 在法律领域的应用引发了关于责任和权利的讨论，这是 AI 治理的重要议题。
